statement: Define a map location and extents from latitude/longitude bounds and return a georeferenced origin that all imported OSM and terrain data share.
superiority: Dino 8 validates the bounds, stores the anchor in the document and keeps every later import aligned without a manual re-seed step.

acceptance.corpus: Five city bounding boxes at latitudes from -45 to 70 degrees
acceptance.tolerance: Round-trip lat/lon to model XY and back within 0.01 m

statement: Import an OpenStreetMap data file and return its nodes as 3D points carrying their OSM identifiers and latitude/longitude.
superiority: Dino 8 streams large extracts without freezing the canvas and reports malformed nodes instead of dropping them silently.

acceptance.corpus: OSM XML extract of a 5 km square of a medium city (about 200k nodes)
acceptance.tolerance: All node IDs retained; point positions within 0.05 m of an independent WGS84 to local-plane projection

statement: Convert OSM ways into polylines grouped by tag keys and values so roads, waterways and land-use outlines can be selected separately.
superiority: Dino 8 offers a typed tag filter with live counts and keeps open ways open and closed ways closed.

acceptance.corpus: OSM extract with highway, waterway, landuse and building ways
acceptance.tolerance: Per-tag feature counts equal a reference OSM parser count; closed/open flag matches way topology for 100 percent of ways

statement: Turn OSM building footprints into extruded massing using height or levels tags, with a documented default when no tag exists.
superiority: Dino 8 repairs self-touching footprints and honours multipolygon courtyards so no solids are invalid.

acceptance.corpus: 200 OSM buildings including 10 multipolygon relations with courtyards
acceptance.tolerance: All solids valid and closed; heights match tag value times level height within 1 cm; courtyard area subtracted within 0.1 percent

statement: Extract the road and path network as centerlines classified by highway type so street hierarchy can drive widths and styling.
superiority: Dino 8 returns a connected network graph with node snapping so routing and offsetting work directly on the result.

acceptance.corpus: OSM extract of a downtown grid and a ring road
acceptance.tolerance: Network connectivity equals reference graph (same component count); classification matches tag for all ways

statement: Build a terrain mesh for the chosen location from SRTM HGT elevation tiles.
superiority: Dino 8 reads void cells explicitly, fills them by documented interpolation and keeps tile seams invisible.

acceptance.corpus: SRTM 1 arc-second tile N47W122 clipped to a 10 km box
acceptance.tolerance: Mesh elevation at 100 random points within 1 m of bilinear interpolation of source cells; zero void-value spikes

statement: Build a terrain mesh from a GeoTIFF digital elevation model clipped to the site extents.
superiority: Dino 8 honours the embedded georeference and nodata value so no user unit or offset fix-up is needed.

acceptance.corpus: GeoTIFF DEM of 30 m cells in a projected CRS covering 20 km
acceptance.tolerance: Vertex elevation within 0.5 m of source after resampling; clip edge within one cell of the boundary

statement: Build a terrain mesh from USGS IMG elevation rasters such as National Map downloads.
superiority: Dino 8 reads the raster natively and warns when the file CRS differs from the project anchor.

acceptance.tolerance: Elevation within 0.5 m of source at 50 sampled cells; CRS reported correctly

statement: Place several OSM extracts or elevation tiles into one site model so overlapping files land at their true geographic positions.
superiority: Dino 8 anchors every import to one shared origin automatically, removing the manual move-by-vector workaround.

acceptance.corpus: Two adjacent OSM extracts with a shared edge street
acceptance.tolerance: Street endpoints coincide within 0.05 m at the seam; no duplicate nodes within the overlap

statement: Resample a terrain mesh to a chosen resolution and clip it to a site boundary while keeping edge heights faithful.
superiority: Dino 8 adapts mesh density to slope so flat areas stay light and steep ground stays accurate.

acceptance.corpus: DEM of rolling hills resampled to 5 m, 10 m and 25 m
acceptance.tolerance: Max vertical deviation from source under 0.5x cell size times local slope; face count monotonic in resolution

statement: Drape imported OSM roads, footprints and points onto the terrain mesh so site features sit on the ground.
superiority: Dino 8 projects with vertex insertion so draped lines follow terrain breaks rather than skipping over them.

acceptance.corpus: Road polylines over a DEM with a 20 m ridge
acceptance.tolerance: Draped polyline vertices lie on mesh within 1 cm; no segment deviates from terrain by more than 0.1 m

statement: Bring the same OpenStreetMap and elevation data into a BIM host so site context appears without leaving the modelling session.
superiority: Dino 8 imports site context natively in the same session with no separate host plug-in.

acceptance.corpus: OSM extract plus DEM imported into a BIM project
acceptance.tolerance: Imported building footprints match source count; terrain elevation within 0.5 m
